headline: Clinical Educator and Product Specialist | Physician-Trained | Healthcare Technology Adoption
summary: MBBS-trained physician with hands-on ICU and emergency experience, including bedside ultrasound and echo, intubation and central line placement, followed by four years at Greenway Health training 200+ clinicians on new workflows. I have trained nurses, providers and 500+ people in safety protocols, and I turn clinical feedback into product requirements. I want to bring that clinical credibility to a surgical product portfolio, supporting customers before and after the sale.
greenway_bullets: Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on new workflows and features.
Ran discovery with close to 200 client practices to document clinical pain points and workflows, then configured solutions to fit them.
Acted as the clinical voice to product teams: wrote PRDs and feature requests from recurring client pain points; many shipped to clients.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference (50 attendees).
skills: physician-trained clinician, product and end-user training, SOP writing, clinical protocols, patient safety review
bedside echo and ultrasound, intubation, central line placement (ICU and emergency)
pre- and post-sale education, clinical support for customers, client presentations, stakeholder communication
thesis_html: Clinicians trust a product specialist who has worked at the bedside.
why_fit: Echo, USG, intubation and central lines, plus COVID ICU care.
Trained providers, nurses and staff on new tools and protocols.
Turned recurring client needs into requirements for product teams.
